prompt_summary: Translate each Lean declaration from the Lean statement alone, with no paper context.
Preserve every visible variable, binder, hypothesis, domain condition, named predicate or wrapper application, equivalence or implication direction, and conclusion.
Do not replace formulas with theorem labels, informal endpoints, or proof-route summaries.

paper_pav_score.tex_statement: {Candidate : Type*} [DecidableEq Candidate] (committee : Finset Candidate) (profile : List (PartyApprovalBallot Candidate)) = partyPAVScore committee profile

paper_pav_seat_score.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row.
paper_pav_seat_score.tex_statement: (partyShare : ℝ) (seats seatCount : ℕ) = partyShare * pavHarmonicSum seatCount + (1 - partyShare) * pavHarmonicSum (seats - seatCount)

paper_proposition1_from_generated_filled.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row.
paper_proposition1_from_generated_filled.tex_statement: For all voter and candidate types with decidable equality, any fractional STV choice rule, two party voter sets, all voters, ballots, two party candidate sets, initial active candidates, initial/global and party weights, PAV seat count, total seats, voter count, and party share: if 0 < partyShare <= 1; seats * (seats + 1) <= voters; the choice rule is Total and QuotaRespecting for STVQuota seats voters; each party has at least seats candidates; both party ballot blocks are SolidCoalitionBallots; initial weights are nonnegative on all voters and have total mass voters; allVoters is the disjoint union of the two party voter sets; party candidate sets are disjoint; both party candidate sets are initially active and initialActive contains only party candidates; the global initial weights restrict to the two party weights with masses partyShare * voters and (1 - partyShare) * voters; and pavSeatCount is paper_pav_min_argmax for partyShare and seats, then the partyFilledSeatCount for partyCandidates in the generated fractionalSTVFilledSeatRunTrace and fractionalSTVFilledSeatRunTerminalActive is paper_seat_share_rounded at partyShare and seats, and pavSeatCount is also paper_seat_share_rounded.
